misses.counterfactual_theory: A record linking frozen forecast specifications and issuance-time evidence cutoffs to eligible matured outcomes could make candidate-level evaluation possible. The supplied evidence does not establish that such a record would have changed a decision or prevented a loss.
misses.decision_reference: research/framework_memory/settlement_evidence/EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36.json and the other supplied EXP-FC settlement records; no linked prior forecast specification, issue time, or eligible evidence cutoff is present.
misses.decision_relevance: This is an auditability and information gap, not a demonstrated decision failure. Confirmed target-time prices alone do not show what was forecast beforehand or what information was available at issuance.
misses.miss_description: The supplied records provide confirmed target-time BTC/ETH mark prices, but do not link them to prior forecast specifications and issuance-time information cutoffs. The repository gap registry likewise identifies missing candidate-to-outcome lineage. No forecast error or missed action can be established from these records.
misses.missing_history_problem: Without frozen forecast specifications, issuance and evidence-cutoff timestamps, and linked eligible matured outcomes, candidate-level accuracy and hindsight exposure cannot be audited. Settlement target timestamps are adjudication times, not decision or source-observation timestamps.
misses.outcome_reference: research/framework_memory/settlement_evidence/EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36.json (target-time settlement); research/framework_memory/task2_archive_first/LATEST.json (EG-FORECAST-OUTCOMES validation reports decision value unproven and no eligible forecast lineage).
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
